facts.business: Safety Controls & Devices Limited operates as an Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) company delivering integrated solutions across power transmission, renewable energy, fire protection systems and institutional infrastructure.
key_risks: Compliance with evolving environmental and safety regulations can increase operational complexities
Intense competition from both established firms and new entrants in the renewable energy sector
Significant upfront costs for equipment and project initiation
Economic conditions, changes in government regulations, tax regime, other statutes, market forces
